form.name: Form 2, Notice of Intention to Drill or Re-enter (with Form 2A reserve pit, Form 3A operator bond, Forms 5 and 6 after work)
form.notes: NOT read from the agency: the blank Form 2 and the rules were not requested. The Commission's site answers only over plain http (the secure address resets automated connections from some networks), so an earlier note that it refused every connection was true of the secure address only. Cells marked form come from search-index snippets of the official form and Title 267 rule text (evidence doc) or from one third-party copy of the form (evidence web), which disagrees with the snippets on bond amounts, so no amounts are given. The Commission's own pages are headed 'Nebraska Oil and Gas Conservation Commission'; no rename to an energy and carbon commission appears on them.

frac_chemicals.n: Required through FracFocus (Rule 3-043: all elements it shows); Form 5 gives only fluid types and volumes

completion_report.n: Forms 5 and 6 are filed after work; online availability not seen

sources.name: Drilling Permits lists, one PDF a year, 2005 to 2025 ('Nebraska Permitted Wells'), on the commission's Data and Publications page
activity_types: permits to drill (development and exploratory wells, oil and gas together)
sources.tested: Read 2026-11-01 over plain http (http://nogcc.ne.gov/Publications/<year>WellPermits.pdf, the address the Commission links by): 2019 to 2025 each answered 200, 15 to 110 KB; 2005 to 2025 are linked (2005 to 2011 as zip or pdf). 2026WellPermits.pdf answers 404: a year's list is posted only after the year closes (2021's in Feb 2022, 2022's in Jan 2023, 2023's in Apr 2024, 2024's in Feb 2025, 2025's in Mar 2026). Text read with pdftotext -layout: a date, then three lines per permit; 2019 and 2020 use one layout and 2021 on another. The list's date is the permit date as listed: it is read as the issue date (API numbers, assigned at issue, run in date order every year; the list is titled 'Permitted Wells'), which the Commission does not state. Three wells whose permit lapsed and was issued again appear on two lists.

grade_reason: The Commission's yearly Drilling Permits lists (PDF, 2005 to 2025) give every permit's date, operator, county, depth, formation and API number, and its wells shapefile and Access database are free bulk files (the Access database has spud and completion dates). Held to B, not A: a list is one PDF a year, posted only after the year closes (2025's in March 2026), so the figures end in December 2025; the list's date is read as the issue date (inferred, not stated); and the lists carry no well type or work type. Nebraska issued 17 permits in 2025. Updated 2026-11-01: the Commission's site answers over plain http (its secure address resets the connection, which the first research took for a refusal of everything); a producer reads the lists, and they match the Commission's own yearly summary for 2019, 2020, 2024 and 2025 and are one permit over in 2021 and 2022.
producer_plan: Built: d11_nat_ne.py. Reads the Drilling Permits PDF of each year over plain http (found on the Data and Publications page) with pdftotext -layout: three lines per permit (operator and driller; well name, footage, location, county; field, proposed depth, formation, API number); a page break can fall inside a permit, so page numbers, headers and footers are dropped first, and an unknown line fails the run. Each permit is one in the month of its listed date. Bands: new by default; inj when the well's name has SWD, WIW, INJ, INJECTION or DISPOSAL (a lower bound); redrill when the API's last four digits are not 0000 or the name says OWWO; rework, amend, other and fluid are null. The API number is read only for those digits. Each run also reads the Commission's yearly Oil Activity Summary and refuses to write if its Permitted Wells table differs from the list by more than 2 permits in total or 4 over the counties. A year counts as closed only when the summary has the table and the year has ended, so the series ends at the newest closed year (December 2025 now); the weekly run reads the newest two years (5 requests, 13 s; a full read 15 requests, 44 s) and picks 2026 up when it appears.
privacy_notes: The lists and files name companies and drillers; the producer reads the permit date, operator, county and the last four digits of the API number only, and names an operator only if it is a corporation, LLC or partnership. Form 2 asks for operator contact details and a signature, and a plat, which would show private land; publish company names and counts only.
